Hi Karen —

Thanks for sending this over and for the heads-up on the renewal. I looped in Ben from billing so we can validate and clear the invoice hold. A couple of quick notes from our end on acceptable documentation:

- We can accept a blanket resale certificate issued by the purchaser (Northbridge) that includes purchaser name, purchaser address, description of business, seller name (if listing multiple sellers, each must be identifiable), and an effective date/signature.
- For interstate sales and drop-ship arrangements, the certificate must indicate that Northbridge is the purchaser and that the goods are purchased for resale.
- The certificate you sent looks close, but our tax team typically needs an explicit seller name or a statement covering purchases from multiple sellers.

Ben — can you review the attached cert and confirm whether the September/October invoices (INV-2026-09-1123 and INV-2026-10-0337) can be released, or if we need a re-signed document on our template? If the latter, I attached a fillable template we can share.

Thanks both —

Priya / Karen —

I reviewed the attached PDF. Two points preventing automatic validation:

1) Seller name: The certificate as submitted lists Northbridge and the buyer address but does not explicitly list "Redwood Inference" or a generic "all vendors" clause that unambiguously covers purchases from Redwood. For interstate and drop-ship situations we need either Redwood named or a statement such as "this certificate covers purchases made from any vendor on behalf of Northbridge Supply."

2) Place of sale: The cert lists the purchaser's address in IL but the document doesn't state whether purchases from the NJ fulfillment partner are covered. For drop-ship orders, we need the cert to indicate it applies to purchases shipped from third-party warehouses or to state that the certificate covers purchases made by Northbridge regardless of seller location.

If you can provide a re-signed copy with one of the two clarifications above we can clear the holds on INV-2026-09-1123 and INV-2026-10-0337 promptly. I attached the fillable template Priya sent; if easier I can send a DocuSign link.
